name: waha
title: WhatsApp (WAHA)
description: A WhatsApp number linked to WAHA, the self-hosted WhatsApp HTTP API — people message the number, an agent answers. WAHA runs as a container next to this instance and posts each message to it.

base_url.label: WAHA URL
base_url.hint: Where the WAHA container answers, from this machine.

session.label: Session
session.hint: The WAHA session this source owns. WAHA Core allows one session, named default.

webhook_url.label: Webhook URL (as WAHA sees this instance)
webhook_url.hint: Verify registers it on the session together with the signing key, so WAHA's deliveries reach this instance signed.
